invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$78.0（基于ATR 0.736和约1.0%风险，进一步收紧），或融资费率转为正值（>0%）显示轧空机会消失，或日线跌破$77关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $78.0 (based on ATR 0.736 and ~1.0% risk, tightened further), or funding rate turns positive (>0%) indicating short squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $77 key support.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2085（基于当前价格$2079.96和约0.2%风险，上调以保护资本），或融资费率Z-score持续>100%且价格下跌，或日线跌破$2050。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2085 (based on current price $2079.96 and ~0.2% risk, raised to protect capital), or funding rate Z-score remains >100% with price decline, or daily break below $2050.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.088（基于ATR 0.0005和约2.8%风险），或融资费率Z-score升至>50%显示轧多风险加剧，或日线跌破$0.085关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.088 (based on ATR 0.0005 and ~2.8% risk), or funding rate Z-score rises to >50% indicating long squeeze risk intensifying, or daily break below $0.085 key support.
